description: Defines the InstagramFeedScreen widget for displaying an Instagram feed in a grid format, fetching data asynchronously via SocialService and using Provider for state management.

classes.name: InstagramFeedScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a route to display an Instagram feed.

classes.name: _InstagramFeedScreenState
classes.description: State class handling the fetching and display of Instagram photos in a grid.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the future to fetch Instagram feed data based on the account handle.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying a loading indicator or a grid of images from Instagram.
